summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated 727 KB payload
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall = `node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs is itself obfuscated (obfuscator.io-style `_0xNNNN` identifiers) and, on `npm install`, checks for a local `bun` binary, and if absent downloads a Bun runtime archive from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/<arch>.zip`, extracts it, chmods it executable, and then invokes it against the co-shipped `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727 KB obfuscator.io-style bundle (rotating string-array constructor `WV8StW`, `hc1jfK9` alphabet decoder, thousands of hex-encoded literals, URL fragments assembled at runtime) shipped with a `// @bun @bun-cjs` header so it can only be executed under the downloaded Bun runtime — evading Node-based inspection. The package's advertised purpose is a React/mobx feature-gate library, which has no need for a second language runtime or an opaque 727 KB payload. The manifest additionally has an empty `author` field and uses the `@servicetitan` scope with peerDependencies on other `@servicetitan/*` packages, matching a scope-impersonation lure shape.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
